Name: Blahaj Fish
Author: BlueGatorade07
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Ever wanted to have Blahaj in your fish tank? Wanted to raise a Blahaj in a fish pond? Now you can with this mod! Blahaj can be fished up on your farm or at the beach, any season, any time, and any weather. Blahaj comes in 8 different colors. The default blue, trans flag, transmasc flag, transfem flag, nonbinary flag, demiboy flag, demigirl flag, and rainbow. Edit the config file or use GMCM to change it.[/color]
